xmldoc.short_description: Find a steady-state operating point of an nflow model.

syntax.syntax_item: [x, u, y, dx] = trim(model, x0, u0)

param_input_item.param_description: a loaded system (name or handle) or the path to a .nflow file.
optional starting continuous state (length nx) for the search.
optional fixed inputs (length nu). External-port Label Source blocks.

param_output_item.param_description: the inputs at the solution (equal to u0).
the state derivative at the solution; its norm measures how close to equilibrium.

description.p: trim finds a steady-state (equilibrium) operating point of model: a continuous state x at which xdot = f(x, u0) = 0 for the fixed inputs u0.
It solves the equation by a Newton iteration on the state Jacobian A = d(xdot)/dx computed by linmod, starting from x0. For a linear model the equilibrium is x = -A\(B*u0), reached in one step.
